query: How much annual leave is allowed?
text: Employees receive 24 days of annual leave per year.

query: How long is the trial period for new hires?
text: New employees complete a 90-day probation period.

query: Can staff do their jobs from home?
text: Remote work is allowed three days each week with manager approval.

query: What should I do if there is a cybersecurity breach?
text: Report security incidents to the security team within one hour.

query: How do we welcome a new customer?
text: Customer onboarding starts with a discovery meeting and a requirements review.
